docs.summary: Tunes how a Light scatters in volumetric fog. Lights without one scatter at their own colour and intensity.
How much this light contributes to volumetric scattering.
If true, the light's shadow map is sampled in the volumetric march so geometry occludes scattering correctly. Costs extra texture lookups per ray-march step.
If true, [`OverrideColor`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.FogLight~OverrideColor) replaces the light's color for fog scattering only (the light's normal direct lighting is unaffected).
Color override for fog scattering. Only used when [`UseOverrideColor`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.FogLight~UseOverrideColor) is true.
Per-light Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy override added to the effect's global Scattering value. 0 = use global, >0 = more forward-scatter (sharper god rays toward this light), <0 = more back-scatter.
Called when the GameObject is added to a Scene. This happens before OnEnable and only once per scene add.
